content_sections.heading: About GSL
content_sections.text: Goa Shipyard Limited (GSL) is a Central Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Defence and a Schedule 'A' Mini Ratna Category-I Company, based at Vaddem, Vasco-Da-Gama, Goa. It designs and builds ships for the Indian Navy, the Indian Coast Guard and other customers, including friendly foreign countries.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Get the application form for the post of Consultant in GSL. It is attached to the notice and also available on www.goashipyard.in. Write the Notice No., its date and the Consultant post you are applying for at the top of the form, and paste a recent photo in the box provided. Fill in your name, father's or husband's name, gender, age with date of birth, present and permanent address, phone or mobile number, email address and educational qualification. List your experience starting from your last organisation and going back to your first, with the designation, the From and To dates and the last salary drawn. Mention in particular your experience at the level of the post you are applying for. Give the names, addresses and phone or mobile numbers of two references, and add any other information. Sign the declaration. If you attach an extra sheet, sign every page. Attach the documents listed under Enclosures and send the application to the address above so that it reaches GSL by 5 November 2026. Interview call letters are sent only by email, so give an email address that you check regularly. If you have difficulty, you can write to [email protected] . content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Age limit: The upper age limit for all three posts is 63 years as on 30.09.2026. Experience is also counted as on 30.09.2026. Essential Educational Qualification: Graduate AND Qualified Chartered Accountant or Cost Accountant. Essential Work Experience: At least 15 years of post-qualification experience in Finance/Internal Audit Functions. Essential Educational Qualification: Bachelor of Engineering (B.E) / Bachelor of Technology (B. Tech) with specialization in Mechanical Engineering. Essential Work Experience: At least 15 years of post-qualification experience in the Shipbuilding Industry in the relevant field, or in other large industrial organizations, in Import/Export and Procurement functions. Experience in handling customs clearance activities at Goa, Mumbai or other Customs locations, as required. Sound knowledge of procurement procedures, including GFR-2017, DAP-2020 and the Manual for Procurement of Goods-2017. Hands-on experience in procurement from both indigenous and global sources, customs clearance, and import/export documentation and compliance. Essential Educational Qualification: Graduate in any discipline from a recognized institution. Essential Work Experience: At least 15 years of post-qualification experience in Purchase and stores functions. All three posts are on contract basis only and give no claim to permanent employment. The engagement is for one year at first. It could be extended by 01 year at a time, or part of a year, until the person turns 65, depending on what the Company needs and how the person performs. The pay is a consolidated monthly amount. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: GSL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: For each post, the notice says the scope of consultancy services is indicative and not exhaustive, and that the Management may also assign other related tasks from time to time. Provide financial advisory inputs to the Project Head on major project proposals, financial decisions and cost implications. Review project cost estimates, expenditure projections, cash flows, funding requirements and cost-to-completion assessments. Advise on suitable financing strategies, cost optimisation and efficient utilisation of project funds. Undertake financial scrutiny of major procurement, contractual and commercial proposals, including variations, claims and additional expenditure. Identify potential financial risks, cost escalations and cash-flow constraints, and recommend appropriate mitigation measures. Provide analytical inputs for financial monitoring, project reviews, management presentations and decision-making. Provide advisory support on import/export logistics, shipment planning and coordination with suppliers and freight agencies. Advise on transit insurance, customs clearance and compliance with applicable customs rules, including IGCR provisions. Provide technical guidance on import documentation and procedures relating to equipment, outfitting items, spares and shipyard equipment. Facilitate matters relating to deferred customs duty payment, AEO certification and liaison with Customs Authorities and other Government agencies. Advise on export documentation, shipping bills, re-export of defective items and compliance with applicable trade regulations. Examine eligibility for export incentives and recommend measures to improve efficiency and compliance in import/export processes. Provide support on engineering stores, inventory management and materials-handling practices. Undertake technical scrutiny of contracts relating to general stores, warehousing, material handling and transportation services. Improvise on stores-related documentation, including CRACs, e-way bills and associated procedural compliance. Review arrangements for receipt, unloading, storage and transportation of materials, and recommend improvements in efficiency and coordination. Undertake technical and commercial scrutiny of bills relating to transportation, material handling and warehouse hiring, in accordance with contractual provisions. Recommend measures for process improvement, cost optimisation and enhanced efficiency in stores and logistics management.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies under Advt. No. 07/2026, one each for Consultant (Infrastructure Finance), Consultant (Import/Export) and Consultant (Stores). All three are on contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the GSL Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The hard copy of the application, with the relevant documents, must reach GSL by 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the GSL Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Consultant (Infrastructure Finance) needs a graduate degree AND qualification as a Chartered Accountant or Cost Accountant. Consultant (Import/Export) needs a B.E / B.Tech with specialization in Mechanical Engineering, and Consultant (Stores) needs a graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized institution. Each post also needs at least 15 years of post-qualification experience in its own field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for GSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for all three Consultant posts is 63 years as on 30.09.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a GSL Consultant?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay is Rs. 1,10,000 for Consultant (Infrastructure Finance), Rs. 85,000 for Consultant (Import/Export) and Rs. 50,000 for Consultant (Stores).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the Goa Shipyard Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed application form and send it, with the documents supporting your age, experience and qualification, to General Manger (HR&A), Goa Shipyard Limited, Vasco-Da-Gama, Goa – 403802. It must reach GSL by 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the GSL Consultant posts?
faq.answer: GSL screens and shortlists the applications, and the Management reserves the right to raise the eligibility criteria for shortlisting. Shortlisted candidates receive interview call letters by email only and are called for a personal interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the GSL Consultant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are on contract basis only and give no claim to permanent employment. The engagement is for one year at first and could be extended by 01 year at a time until the person turns 65, depending on the Company's needs and the person's performance.

faq.question: Q9. Will GSL pay TA/DA for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA / DA will be paid to candidates called for the personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents must be attached to the GSL application form?
faq.answer: Attach identity proof, a copy of the last pay certificate, address proof, a copy of the certificate proving your educational qualification and a copy of the service verification certificate, along with all documents supporting your age, experience and qualification.
